metadata.title: Connected Coffee Fleet OTA + Cloud Architecture POA&M

poam-items.title: Enforce tighter telemetry replay window constraints
poam-items.description: Enforce tighter telemetry replay window constraints

risks.title: Audit log tampering risk
risks.description: Log tampering could conceal OTA incident traces and delay response.
risks.statement: Core logging exists; immutability hardening is incomplete.

risks.title: Telemetry replay distortion risk
risks.description: Replayed telemetry can distort observability and trigger noisy operational decisions.
risks.statement: Replay controls are present but require aggressive tuning under burst traffic.

risks.title: Device identity spoofing risk
risks.description: Spoofed devices may inject telemetry and OTA requests without strong identity controls.
risks.statement: Identity validation is active; replay hardening remains under review.

risks.title: Malicious OTA payload execution risk
risks.description: Tampered firmware artifacts could execute on fleet devices if signature enforcement drifts.
risks.statement: Verification and signer controls are strong with regular regression checks.
